snippet.title: Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the Official Launch Trailer for Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy, a hunting action shooting simulation game developed by Cradle Games and Play Mechanix. Players will take on nine unique animal Adventures spanning a variety of worldwide environments with over three times the content of previous games in the franchise. Hunt a wide range of beasts, including Cheetahs, Black Panthers, Woolly Mammoths, and more across solo and multiplayer modes. Big Buck Hunter: Ultimate Trophy is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
